name: afk-cat
description: A Tamagotchi-style AFK cat that lives in a Claude Code pane, earns coins while you idle and while Claude works

flavor.title: Catppuccin flavor
flavor.description: auto follows Claude Code's theme; daycycle is Latte by day, Frappé at dusk, Mocha at night. Also latte, frappe, macchiato, mocha

skin.title: Cat interface
skin.description: full redraws the spinner, turn line, prompt hint, tool rows and a walking-cat band; light only the spinner, turn line and hint; off leaves Claude Code alone

sound.title: Sound effects
sound.description: Chiptune clips on level-up, evolution, adoption and achievements

canvas.title: Pane canvas
canvas.description: auto draws the scene as a 4x pixel picture where the terminal shows images (kitty, Ghostty) and as half-block cells elsewhere; image or text forces one

reactions.title: Claude reactions
reactions.description: on animates and shows lines; quiet animates; off disables reactions

speech.title: Cat speech
speech.description: on speaks about the yard and Claude; quiet skips idle and tool chatter; off keeps the hourly idle line only
